name: KING-CORE
source:
Protagonist of the evil route of Daiteikoku.

[spoiler]When he was human, he was a vicious criminal that was sentenced to 800 years of hard labour for 125 brutal crimes. His brain was moved in into a cyborg body to fight for Gamerica and so he has become a CORE. The first CORE to regain its human memories. It happened after he was addressed by Carol.

At current moment leads a group of villain CORE with the intent of subverting humanity for their entertainment.[/spoiler]

"We are crazy. We love to slaughter, we love to destroy, we love to rape."
